def VTask.subtypePreimage : {α : Sort u_1} → {β : Sort u_4} → (p : α → Prop) → [DecidablePred p] → (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) → { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) 
  := λ α β p _dec_p x₀ => 
    let forward : {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} → ({a // ¬p a} → β) := λ x s => x.val s.val
    let inv : ({a // ¬p a} → β) → {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} := λ y => 
      let f : α → β := λ a => 
        if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, h⟩
      ⟨f, λ s => 
        let a := s.val
        let h_s := s.prop
        let h_eq : h = h_s := 
          let _ := Classical.propExt (isProp.mpr (p a))
          Eq.refl h
        show f a = x₀ s from 
          by simp [f]; rw [Subtype.eq rfl h_eq]⟩
    ⟨ forward, inv, 
      λ y => funext (λ s => by simp [inv, forward]), 
      λ x => funext (λ s => by simp [inv, forward]) ⟩
